description: Start here when a user asks for an email signature. From what you already know about them (person, company, brand colour, logo URL, website, socials, department, sector, team size) it builds 3–4 professional designs with the app's 13 templates (each a different angle: clean, call-to-action, campaign banner, sign-off), chosen by the playbook for that role and sector. Returns ONE preview_url that renders all of them side by side in the user's browser (data in the URL fragment, nothing stored), a claim_url per design (opens the ProSignature app with that design loaded; the human signs up free and upgrades there), the free do-it-yourself version as paste-ready HTML, the three ways to install with prices from pricing.json, and present_to_user: a short message you can adapt. Nothing is fetched from logo_url server-side.

colour.description: Brand colour #rrggbb (from the logo or website; default #E8604C)

cta.description: Call to action; default comes from the playbook for the sector/department

department.description: sales | customer_support | executive | marketing | hr_recruiting | engineering | finance | legal (guessed from the title when omitted)

language.description: Language of the preview page and present_to_user (default en)

logo_url.description: https URL of the company logo (website header, favicon at full size, or an image in a recent email). Shown in the preview; imported and hosted on sign-up.

sector.description: real_estate | legal | accounting_finance | insurance | healthcare | saas_tech | agency_creative | consulting_coaching | education | nonprofit | construction_trades | hospitality | retail_ecommerce | fitness_beauty | recruiting_staffing | photography | automotive | travel

social_links.description: Profile URLs or handles: linkedin, instagram, x, facebook, whatsapp (number), tiktok, pinterest, youtube

team_size.description: People who need a signature, the user included (default 1); prices the Teams option

name: design_signatures
title: Design 3–4 signatures for your user (no account)
